$comment: Mirror of sprk_analysisaction.sprk_inputschema for compose-summarize-word-changes (spaarkeai-compose-r2 task 043, FR-10). Normalized OpenAI-function-parameters subset. Consumes the compose-document JPS scope; changesText (a textual representation of the tracked changes parsed by DocxAnnotationReader, task 051) is the load-bearing LLM input. REVIEW FLAG: exact upstream shape confirmed when 051/054 land. Property-level "required": true is FORBIDDEN. No actionId (assigned at deploy, task 047). actionCode carries NO version suffix.

changesText.description: Textual representation of the tracked changes (insertions/deletions/comments/structural) parsed from the document returned from Word. Supplied by the return-from-Word flow.
changesText.elicitation_prompt: I'll summarize the changes made in Word.
changesText.ledger_resolution: compose.wordChanges — the tracked-change set parsed by DocxAnnotationReader (task 051) on return from Word (compose-document scope)
